title: Boquete,_Panama.jpg
author: Michael (a.k.a. moik) McCullough
description: Boquete is a delightful town in the mountain highlands of Panama. The high altitude makes for a cooler Panama as opposed to Panama City and Bocas Del Toro. It is surrounded by lush jungle forests and coffee fincas. In Spanish Boquete means "gap," not boquet - but it seems like a boquet because of all the flowers.
